page.layout: One column of running text, set in verse stanzas, with short poem titles above the stanzas. A large title "VERIS DESCRIPTIO" with subtitle sits at full width below the rule. Below the last poem is a drop-cap poem and a signature at the right foot. No margin notes.

main_text.head: Iphicratis dictum.

p.i: Vallaret vigil hoste non propinquo Cur castra, Iphicrates rogatus, inquit: Non est vox duce digna, Non putaram.

main_text.head: Senectus.

p.i: Dulcia præterita senium sic gaudia vitæ[?] Pensat, ut aprici commoda veris hyems.
Taurus atrox cornu, cervus pede, dentis aper vi, Ungue Leæna, manu denique præstat homo. Hac tauros superare valet, cervoque Leasque, Hac aprina gravì subdere colla iugo.

main_text.head: Eusthatio Turcamo.

p.i: Turcame, amor Charitũ, Graia pia cura Minerva, Turcame, præcipuo fœdere iuncte[?] mihi. Aecipe lætanti fusum tibi pectore salve: Accipe quod mœsto vix loquor ore, vale.

main_text.head: VERIS DESCRIPTIO, Ex Anacreonte desumpta.
main_text.p: ASpice uti Charitum sub amœni exordia Veris Affluit innumeris inclita turba rosis.

page.notes: Long s rendered as plain s throughout. Words read with doubt: "vitæ" (ligature unclear), "Leasque", "iuncte" (ct ligature), "grauì" changed to "gravì" by the u/v rule, signature "I." possibly J. The red underlines and the ornamental initial are not printed text and were left out. The drop-cap A is joined to "Spice".
